d:
Do shakarkand se banayein vrat wale gulab jamun - bina maida, bina baking soda, mawa jaisa swad!
Masala Kitchen mein Poonam Devnani sikhati hain shakarkand ke rasile gulab jamun, jo phatte nahi aur andar tak pakte hain. Navratri aur vrat mein bhi khane layak, sasti si mithai.
Shakarkand ke vrat wale gulab jamun - bina maida, bina baking powder/soda
Kam paani mein shakarkand ubalne ka sahi tarika
Milk powder se mawa jaisa texture, jamun phatte nahi
Donut shape kyun - andar se kachche nahi lagte
Bonus: paneer ke saath shakarkand ka farari donut
